component.name: Andy
component.summary: Modern GTK4 and Wayland-native scrcpy GUI for Android mirroring

description.p: Andy is a fast, responsive, and elegant Libadwaita wrapper for scrcpy on Linux desktops. It enables high-framerate screen mirroring, webcam streaming, audio forwarding, and lightweight keyboard and mouse input bridging with zero overhead.

ul.li: Dynamic native resolution calculation with proportional quality presets
Virtual display generation with dynamic flex aspect ratio adjustment (scrcpy 5.0)
Front, back, and external camera streaming with high-speed framerate selection
Low-latency UHID keyboard, mouse, and physical gamepad forwarding
Dedicated Connect M/K mode for broken screens or high-efficiency typing
Orientation awareness and live rotation monitoring
Wayland-native Libadwaita interface with Light and Dark GNOME Circle styling

description.p: Introduced Amberol-style seamless immersive titlebar (textless, borderless, floating window controls), true light and deep obsidian dark theming (zero grey backgrounds), unified sidebar canvas with colored accents, and multi-distro installation support with Fedora udev rules.
Introduced permanent non-collapsible slim utility sidebar, full GNOME Circle theming for light and dark modes, FreeDesktop XDG specifications, sleep inhibitor, and scrcpy 5.0 feature suite.
